title: [YSQL] [Transactional DDL] Created index inside the transaction block still persist after ROLLBACK of the transaction
body:
Jira Link: [DB-16200](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-16200)
### Description

In master - 2.25.2.0-b316
Schema ,
`CREATE TABLE trigger_test(id INT PRIMARY KEY, val TEXT);`
steps :
```
db3=# begin isolation level repeatable read;
BEGIN
db3=*# create index idx1 on trigger_test (id);
NOTICE:  making create index for table "trigger_test" nonconcurrent
DETAIL:  Create index in transaction block cannot be concurrent.
HINT:  Consider running it outside of a transaction block. See https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/6240.
CREATE INDEX
db3=*# 
db3=*# \d+ trigger_test;
                                       Table "public.trigger_test"
 Column |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default | Storage  | Compression | Stats target | Description 
--------+---------+-----------+----------+---------+----------+-------------+--------------+-------------
 id     | integer |           | not null |         | plain    |             |              | 
 val    | text    |           |          |         | extended |             |              | 
Indexes:
    "trigger_test_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, lsm (id HASH)
    "idx1" lsm (id HASH)
Triggers:
    trig_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON trigger_test FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trig_func()
Access method: heap

db3=*# rollback;
ROLLBACK
```
after rollback;

```
db3=# SELECT indexname, indexdef
FROM pg_indexes
WHERE tablename = 'trigger_test';
     indexname     |                                     indexdef                                     
-------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 trigger_test_pkey | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX trigger_test_pkey ON public.trigger_test USING lsm (id HASH)
 idx1              | CREATE INDEX idx1 ON public.trigger_test USING lsm (id HASH)
(2 rows)
db3=# \d+ trigger_test;
                                       Table "public.trigger_test"
 Column |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default | Storage  | Compression | Stats target | Description 
--------+---------+-----------+----------+---------+----------+-------------+--------------+-------------
 id     | integer |           | not null |         | plain    |             |              | 
 val    | text    |           |          |         | extended |             |              | 
Indexes:
    "trigger_test_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, lsm (id HASH)
    "idx1" lsm (id HASH)
Triggers:
    trig_before_insert BEFORE INSERT ON trigger_test FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trig_func()
Access method: heap
```
